coverage: Twenty dzongkhags and 205 gewog reference areas, OCHA ROAP / HDX 2020 geometry. Trashiyangtse uses its full current name rather than source shorthand Yangtse. District populations are official NSB 2024 projections based on the 2017 census; no gewog populations are inferred. The reference layer does not separately delineate urban thromdes; it must not be interpreted as a complete map of municipal governance. Subdivision names are English only. Shared display borders follow the existing atlas India and China reference geometry.
processing: Full available source resolution retained, cleaned together and rounded to six decimal places. Shared internal edges stored once; unselected coasts have no stroke. Deeper geometry loads only for the selected region. All views use the shared regional renderer, selected-outline index, adaptive detail, lifecycle and three-country cache. Territorial waters are excluded from land fills. Territory context features carry their own destination bounds.
